description: This file defines a Grain class for Orleans, implementing stream subscription, unsubscription, and message handling with a focus on immutability testing. It also includes a serializable data class used within the grain.

classes.name: StreamingImmutabilityTestGrain
classes.description: A Grain class implementing stream subscription and messaging logic for immutability testing.

classes.name: StreamImmutabilityTestObject
classes.description: A serializable data class used within the stream messages, containing a single string property.

methods.name: SubscribeToStream
methods.description: Subscribes to a specified stream with a handler for incoming messages.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromStream
methods.description: Unsubscribes the grain from the current stream subscription.

methods.name: SendTestObject
methods.description: Sends the stored test object onto the stream.

methods.name: SetTestObjectStringProperty
methods.description: Sets the MyString property of the test object.

methods.name: GetTestObjectStringProperty
methods.description: Retrieves the MyString property of the test object.

methods.name: GetSiloIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the silo hosting the grain.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handler invoked when a new message is received on the stream; updates the local test object.
